rapport_notes: Professional and competent; some awkwardness in name/email capture; no personality or warmth in closer.
process_discipline_notes: On-time guarantee mentioned once in Stage 2 close pitch with no prior mention in Stage 1 (not a repeat, so no violation there); however, the close ('any questions for me?') is asked but not followed by silence — rep immediately adds 'I'll send' language and moves to goodbye without holding space.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Well, I'm gonna run you through some questions and then I'll be able to get you all the pricing and info at the end, it'll probably take about ten minutes or so does that work?
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Cool and anything at the moment that you're like, particularly concerned about outside of obviously just a a quote that we'll get you. [Customer: No.]
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'No' to concerns; rep acknowledged and pivoted immediately to logistics (pickup address) with no follow-up or second layer.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Not explicitly asked or answered. Insurance mentioned only as 'damage coverage which is just higher evaluation for your items that's included in the rate' — no 'careful with' framing or $2,000 coverage language.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Not covered. No mention of Meet Your Mover, background checks (mentioned as fact but not as a 'meet your crew' differentiator), or day-before call.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: we do have an on time guarantee. So forever late we do discount your money back.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: typically a one bedroom apartment will take about two and a half to three and a half hours to move. I would actually put you over that range just because of the third floor with stairs... So I actually would probably put you in the range of about four to five hours
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_window: you do only pay for time use the miscellaneous items do add the most time
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_beats_it: once we exceed the minimum we bill in fifteen minute increments until the move is completed, so you would just pay for time used.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_self_prep: the main thing that adds the most time for us is loose miscellaneous items that don't get box, so yeah the better kind of prepped and pac you are, the more efficiently we can move
evidence_quotes.close_implicit: any questions for me? [Customer: No.] You're welcome. You have a great rest of your day.
evidence_quotes.missing_rate_lock: No mention of 'your rate locks when you book' or explicit booking call-to-action.

top_strength: Strong logistics probe and personalized estimate anchoring—Calvin gathered detailed floor/elevator/distance context and credibly tailored the 4–5 hour range rather than defaulting to generic benchmarks.
coaching_note: You asked the agenda question *after* probing instead of before, drew no concerns to work with, and never covered damage coverage differentiator, Meet Your Mover, communication plan, or a rate-lock close—all of which would have addressed the gaps and earned the booking.
